mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in federal funds rate below 0.1% signals extreme monetary easing that stimulates economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 900.0) and retail sales (RSAFS < 420000.0) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 900.0 and RSAFS < 420000.0, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) signals labor market deterioration that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) reflects robust economic activity and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 850.0 units (HOUST < 850.0) signals housing sector contraction and weak consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 850.0, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) triggers central bank tightening expectations that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS < 138000.0) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0) indicate severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS < 138000.0 and UNRATE > 6.0, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.02.
